label.name: evaluator-only fixed-15-minute net outcome
label.definition: per grid row: a hypothetical buy of 10^16 wei at cutoff + 2 s through PonsPaperExecution.plan_buy on a FRESH execution object; the position's own reserve delta is carried exactly as the loop's settlement path carries it; the exit is plan_sell on the tape advanced by the recorded external events at entry_fill_block_timestamp + 900 s. net = quote_out - spent - gas_buy - gas_sell - approval with the D10 gas constants, computed by the same arithmetic ExecutionPolicy._settle uses. The label is POSITIVE iff net > 0.
label.unresolved: Unresolved (route transition, coverage) or QuoteError (exhausted curve) -> label UNRESOLVED, excluded from AUC and counted
it_never: touches the ledger or a checkpoint
label.known_answer_test_written_before_the_gri: the label function, run at the recorded cutoffs of the 16 settled D10 entries on d10-backfill-v1, reproduces each recorded net to the wei (|difference| < 1e-18 ETH).

spec: docs/SPEC.md, the D11-001 owner spec (2026-09-13), the owner's decision on the data (a NEW 12-hour backfill d11-backfill-v1 through the local Nitro node) and the thirteen Fable addenda
base_config: experiments/d11/config.json — admission_v2 constants, pons_context_v2 features and scales, pons_encoder_v2 input_schema_sha256, reinforcement.new_full_scale and the clean reference checkpoint are read from there and are NOT restated here

registration.rule: Fable addendum 2. This file and the PLAN.md section 7 are committed ALONE, before any request to any node, before the collection and before any D11-001 number exists. Step (iii) writes the window, the cutoff, the tick counts, the geometric ceiling, the grid row count and the label class balance — numbers only — and the brain runs only after step (iii).
registration.nothing_is_re_chosen_after_a_result: no threshold, window, hold, concurrency or scale moves after a result is observed. If something cannot be done as specified the deviation is declared in this plan, the report and HANDOFF; nothing is absorbed silently.

fixed_for_the_whole_wave.decoder: the stored k = 8 decoder, baseline -0.844389816810345 Hz, theta 0.9117185769796697 Hz
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.k_means_the_readout_replicate_count: the owner's 'k=8' is the number of readout replicates per candidate evaluation. Candidates per round stay 6.
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.forgetting: the Pons loop never calls mb.forget(); 'disable learning and forgetting' is satisfied by FROZEN mode, and a test asserts each frozen branch's end digest equals its start digest.

layout.dataset: data/pons/d11-backfill-v1/  (events.jsonl, headers.jsonl, raw.jsonl, discovery.json, initial_states.json, cursor.json, MANIFEST.json) — the D10 store layout
layout.initial_states_are_mandatory: the offline tracker needs initial_states.json for exact reconstruction; a store without it is refused
layout.d10_is_untouched: experiments/d10/, data/pons/d10-backfill-v1/, data/market, upstream, tests/upstream_audit, experiments/d7, d8, d9b and experiments/historical/runs do not change in this wave; d10-backfill-v1 stays as the historical baseline.

node.rule: 127.0.0.1 only. No socket is ever opened to anything else. The stockroom .env is neither read nor written in this wave.
discovery_order: then the loopback host ports published by a local container whose image identifies a Nitro node, ascending — read from the local container list, which sends no request to any node
then any other loopback port served by a local Ethereum node process already running (e.g. anvil), ascending
node.discovery_deviation_declared_before_the_: addendum 3 names 8547 then 8545. Those two are probed first and in that order. The extension to the published loopback ports of a local Nitro container and to other local node processes is a DECLARED widening of the port list, registered here BEFORE the first request, because the owner's decision put discovery in the agent's hands ('Agente descobre sozinho') and told it to verify the endpoint rather than assume a port. The VERIFICATION rule is not widened at all.
node.never_probed: no JSON-RPC request is sent to a loopback port that is not served by an Ethereum node process — a database, a cache, a browser or an editor port is never posted to.
node.verification: a candidate is verified only if eth_chainId returns 4663 AND the timestamp of its `latest` block is within 300 s of wall clock. The first verified candidate in the order above is used and every port probed is reported with what it answered.
node.endpoint_file: experiments/d11/local_node.env, key LOCAL_NITRO_RPC_HTTP, passed through the existing --env-file/--env-key path. A loopback URL is not a secret and is committed.
probe_contents: eth_chainId and eth_getBlockByNumber('latest') per candidate port
eth_blockNumber and eth_getBlockByNumber('safe') on the chosen endpoint
eth_getBlockByNumber at the block about 12 h back, with a bounded refinement
one eth_getLogs over one collector-sized chunk (1,000 blocks, factory filter) at the old end of the window
one eth_call creatorTaxBps() at an old block — the only kind of historical eth_call the D10 backfill and the live driver make
node.no_fallback: if any of those fails, or needs state the local node does not hold, the wave STOPS with the exact list (method, block, purpose, count) and its Chainstack cost in units. Chainstack is used only after the owner authorises that list. There is no automatic fallback and --allow-remote is never passed.

budget.classification: flytrade.pons.budget classifies an endpoint by host: 127.0.0.1, localhost and ::1 are LOOPBACK, everything else is REMOTE.
budget.loopback_ledger: experiments/d11/rpc_ledger_local.json — its own file, its own counters, independent of experiments/d10/rpc_ledger.json
budget.chainstack_unchanged: the Chainstack caps (wave 10,000 / run 5,000 / day 10,000), its ledger and its accounting do not move in this wave
budget.remote_is_refused: a ledger opened in loopback scope refuses a non-loopback endpoint with RPC_REMOTE_REFUSED before the socket opens, unless --allow-remote is passed. The agent never passes it, and the report states the remote request count, which must be 0.

projection.rule: three times the projected request count of the 12-hour collection, from the collector's chunking and the D10 MANIFEST per-method counts scaled by block count
arithmetic: blocks = 43,200 s / 0.101 s per block (the D10 measured median interval) = 427,723
grid headers, one per HEADER_GRID_BLOCKS = 100 plus two: 427,723 / 100 + 2 = 4,279  (D10: 331 eth_getBlockByNumber over 33,198 blocks of the resumed segment = 9.97 per 1,000 blocks)
factory eth_getLogs, one per FACTORY_CHUNK_BLOCKS = 1,000 segment: 428

curve eth_getLogs: 428 segments x ceil(tracked/250) address batches x ceil(1000/500) chunks. D10 measured 3.94 curve requests per segment at ~440 native launches tracked per hour; projected at 6 per segment to leave room for a larger tracked set: 2,568
eth_call creatorTaxBps fallback: D10 needed 3 in 991 launches; scaled to ~5,300 launches and rounded up: 20
eth_chainId / eth_blockNumber / latest and safe headers: 10
projection.cap_rule: 3 x 7,400 = 22,200, registered here before the first request and not raised afterwards
projection.if_the_cap_is_reached: the collection stops there with its cursor and ledger on disk and the report says so. The cap is not raised after seeing a result.

window.rule: 12 contiguous hours ending at the confirmed head at probe time. end_block = the confirmed block, which is min(head - confirm_depth, safe) with the collector's own confirmation definition (confirm_depth measured at probe time from the local node, safe used when the endpoint answers the tag). start_block = the smallest block whose timestamp is >= timestamp(end_block) - 43,200.
window.no_overlap: the window must not overlap d10-backfill-v1 (2026-09-12T01:37:36Z - 2026-09-12T03:53:25Z, blocks 60721229-60801426). If it would, the end is moved earlier until it does not. A test asserts the disjointness on the written MANIFEST.

also_records: sha256 and byte size of every file

window.collected_once: the store is collected once and persisted. Every later step reads the store; no later step opens a socket, and a test parses run.py, grid.py and evaluate.py for network verbs and for flytrade.pons.rpc, as D11 already does for its own scripts.
window.tick_grid: 30-second ticks anchored at t0 = timestamp(start_block). Every partition, every replay branch and the evaluation grid use this one grid, so a cutoff is the same instant everywhere.

split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block). T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)), snapped DOWN to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0.
split.computed_from_timestamps_only: T is computed before any outcome, any label and any neural number, and is recorded in step (iii).

learning_partition.entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + latency + horizon = cutoff + 902 <= T
learning_partition.boundary_ticks: ticks in (T - 902, T] observe, mark and settle, and never enter
learning_partition.assertion: the run fails if a learning position is open at T

frozen_partition.market_state: the frozen loop branches rebuild the market from t0 without the brain: the first frozen tick ingests every event at or before T, and the brain evaluates nothing before T

split.temporal_blocks: three blocks of equal duration over the FROZEN grid span [first frozen cutoff, last frozen cutoff]; a row belongs to the block its cutoff falls in, the last block closed at the right
split.geometric_ceiling: the number of non-overlapping 932-second slots (902 s of latency+horizon plus one 30-second tick) between the first LEARNING tick that has at least one v2-eligible candidate and T - 902

learning_run.starts_from: the clean reference checkpoint under from_clean_reference
learning_run.records: as D10 writes them — ROUND (every presented candidate's score), DECISION, EXECUTION, OUTCOME, LEARNING, CHECKPOINT — and each LEARNING record additionally carries the raw net outcome, the normalised amount, the full scale it was divided by and a clipped flag (amount == cap)
learning_run.final_checkpoint: TRAINED; its digest is recorded in the run summary and in the grid manifest
learning_run.one_brain: one learned brain is carried across tokens for the whole partition

grid.what_it_is: a market-only scoring pass, not the loop. Presentation inside the loop depends on run state — while a position is held only the held token is presented, and the round-robin advances with evaluated rounds — so two frozen loop branches cannot share rows. The grid is therefore built from the store alone.
construction: for every FROZEN tick, reconstruct the tape of every tracked token from the store alone (the retrospective tracker, exact with initial_states.json)
apply admission_v2 at that cutoff and take ALL eligible candidates: no cap of 6, no rotation, no hold mode. This is a superset of anything either loop branch could have presented.

score each candidate with BOTH frozen brains using the standard readout: k = 8 replicates under comparison_v1, seeds from (observation_id, stable_id, replicate index) and independent of the checkpoint digest
grid.rows: keyed by (cutoff_ts, stable_id), identical across branches by construction
per_row_and_branch: decoded action at the k = 8 thresholds
grid.coverage: rows VALID in both branches / rows
grid.read_only: both frozen brains are loaded read-only and their digests are verified before and after the pass. No execution, no bankroll, no reinforcement and no checkpoint write happens in the grid.

statistics.primary: dAUC = AUC(TRAINED) - AUC(REFERENCE), over rows VALID in both branches that carry a settled label
statistics.auc: Mann-Whitney U / (n_pos * n_neg), ties counted one half

uncertainty.method: paired cluster bootstrap by stable_id — a token's rows move together

statistics.wording_rule: an interval that includes 0 is reported as 'compatible with sampling variation'; one that does not is reported with its bounds. Never 'significant', never 'proves', no rate asserted as measured. An AUC near 0.5 is not evidence that no signal exists.
secondary_descriptive: Spearman(score, net) per branch and their difference
the distribution of the per-row score difference TRAINED - REFERENCE

suppression.on_the_grid: BUY-crossing rate (valence > theta) per branch, overall, per block and by later outcome class
suppression.preregistered_reading: the between-class difference of the trained-minus-reference change, with the same clustered interval: 'global' if that interval includes 0, 'contextual' if it excludes 0 with the larger drop in the negative class. Nothing else is said in words.

known_answer_tests: AUC 1, 0 and 0.5 on perfect, reversed and constant toy data

saturation.definition: computed offline from the logged normalised vectors u = tanh(raw / scale). flytrade.encoder.MarketToSensoryEncoder.weights clips u to [-1, 1] (flytrade/encoder.py:228) and never logs that it did, so saturation is read off the vector: a channel is SATURATED when |u| >= 1 - 1e-12, which is where the clip bites and where float64 tanh has already reached 1.0 (|raw/scale| >~ 19.06).
reported: the fraction of (row, channel) pairs saturated
the fraction of rows with at least one saturated channel

verbatim_from_the_owner: fewer than 100 paired FROZEN candidate labels
either positive or negative outcome class has fewer than 20 labeled examples
material encoder saturation or invalid-state rate above 5%

operationalised.completed_LEARNING_episodes: settled episodes that produced a LEARNING record in the learning branch
operationalised.paired_FROZEN_candidate_labels: grid rows VALID in both branches with a settled (non-UNRESOLVED) label
operationalised.class_counts: positive = net > 0, negative = net <= 0, over the paired labelled rows
operationalised.paired_neural_coverage: rows VALID in both branches / all grid rows
operationalised.saturation_and_invalid_state: the (row, channel) saturated fraction > 5 %, or the INVALID_STATE rate on the grid > 5 %

inconclusive_conditions.do_not_loosen: these thresholds are not loosened after the run. Three of them are pre-computable and are checked in step (iii): fewer than 100 settled grid labels, fewer than 20 in either class, or a geometric ceiling under 20 ends the wave with a report and no neural run.

frozen_loop_branches.what_they_are: two FROZEN replays over the FROZEN partition — frozen_trained and frozen_reference — with paper trading, as D10's frozen_reference ran: SETTLED_FROZEN settlements, no LEARNING record, end digest equal to start digest
frozen_loop_branches.they_are_descriptive: their PnL, action frequencies and holding durations are the FROZEN 'paper results'. They are NOT the primary comparison and they do not decide which observations the grid contains.

live_hour.when: only after the replay report is written
live_hour.learning: LEARN — the declared d11-001 live branch keeps learning enabled
live_hour.starts_from: the TRAINED checkpoint; its state digest is verified on disk and recorded as starts_from_digest
live_hour.endpoint: the same local node under the loopback ledger, with the chainId gate (4663) and the 120-second freshness rule
live_hour.if_not_fresh_at_start: the live hour is NOT started and that is reported. It is not worked around.
live_hour.no_tuning: the same configuration, no parameter changes between replay and live, and the two are reported separately
live_hour.no_real_money: paper only. No signing, no funds, no broadcast; the RPC method allowlist carries no signing method.

observer.root: a D11 root is added to observer/serve.py ROOTS and the observer is restarted on localhost:8793
observer.a_finished_run_is_a_record: a finished run is labelled a record of an hour that already ended, never a fly operating now

success_is_not: a profit, a win rate or a BUY frequency
any comparison of d11-001 with d10-001, which ran a different environment and a different window
an_integrated_environment_repair: admission, sensory context and the reinforcement scale moved together in D11. A behavioural difference between TRAINED and REFERENCE here is a difference between one brain that saw 8.4 hours of this environment and one that saw none; it can never be attributed to any one of the three D11 changes.
